description: Inspect this project now: returns documentation audit findings, committed-diff review findings, decision/map status, and a quickstart playbook. Quickstart and map modes are read-only and deterministic. Explicit mode: setup configures MCP, instructions and lifecycle hooks to use mason on PATH while retaining original audit evidence; use it only when the user requests setup. Optional host selects codex or claude. Optional base selects the review comparison; evidence imports CI manifests with check outcomes, commit freshness, and links to changed files and accepted decisions. mode: map returns the full Map-Reduce build workflow. Repeat calls refresh findings even after setup.

base.description: Git ref for committed-diff review. Defaults to the first available main branch ref.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

evidence.description: Repository-local CI evidence manifests to include in the review. Imports Vitest JSON, SARIF, and native-validator mason-check-json results without executing check commands.

host.description: Assistant to configure in setup mode; inferred only when unambiguous.

mode.description: Quickstart inspects without edits; map requests an architecture build; setup installs the shared onboarding flow.

name: mason_init
